Subject: Re: Billing: agency fees for Oct/Nov — VAT handling?

Hi Claire — thanks for the note. Short answer: likely yes, but we need to validate your VAT registration and confirm the preferred flow. Two common patterns we use: 

- Reverse-charge (customer-accountable): If Storaxis is VAT-registered in the UK and the supply is B2B, we can issue a net invoice (no UK VAT) and annotate the invoice for reverse-charge. For that we need a current VAT ID and one piece of supporting evidence (VAT certificate or a successful VIES lookup).

- Self-billing: If your AP team prefers to self-bill (generate invoices on your side), we'll need a signed self-billing agreement on file and a primary contact for monthly reconciliation.

Can you share: 1) your VAT ID, 2) whether you want us to issue net invoices (reverse-charge) or set up a self-bill arrangement, and 3) a PO number if you want it on the invoice.

I've looped in Marissa from Billing and Ben on Collection Ops so they can flag any process changes on our end. For reference this is tracked under HubSpot deal HS-432112.

Best,

Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0198

Hi Claire,

Thanks Jonas — hi Claire. Quick note from Billing on the exact evidence and operational steps.

1) Evidence required for reverse-charge / net invoice:
   - Valid UK VAT number (we will also do a VIES check) OR
   - Official VAT registration certificate (PDF) if VIES is showing intermittent results.

2) Self-billing: if Storaxis wants to self-bill we require a signed self-bill agreement before we stop issuing invoices. I have attached our redwood-self-bill-template.pdf for your legal/AP to review.

3) If we cannot validate the VAT ID by the invoice date, the system will generate an invoice with UK VAT (we can issue a corrected credit/debit once validation is provided, but that delays reconciliation).

Operational items we need from you to proceed today:
- VAT ID (exact string as registered)
- Preferred flow: "reverse-charge (issue net invoice)" OR "self-bill (Storaxis will issue)"
- PO number to appear on invoice (optional, but helpful for automated matching)

Payment terms are our standard NET 30. If you share the VAT registration PDF we will run it through accounting and, assuming the ID validates, issue an updated net invoice. I attached a short request form (storaxis-vat-certificate-request-form.docx) that lists the exact fields we capture.

Attachment stubs:
- redwood-self-bill-template.pdf
- storaxis-vat-certificate-request-form.docx
- preview: redwood-invoice-INV-8957.pdf (this is the current invoice reflecting gross VAT — we'll reissue if we validate reverse-charge)

If you prefer, Ben can pick up a quick call with your AP to walk through the self-bill signoff.

Cheers,

Marissa Cole
Senior Billing Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
